q: Khurja potteries fire on LDO, RPO and piped gas: what does the cluster use, and which loan pays for a better kiln?
title: Khurja potteries: fuels and a kiln loan
short: About 400 units fire 156 kilns mostly on LDO and rubber process oil, burning about 19,000 kL a year, with about 10 units on piped gas. Khurja is on BEE's ADEETIE ceramic cluster list, which cuts interest on an energy loan if the project saves at least 10%. A shuttle kiln upgrade clears that easily.
audience: Crockery, insulator, bone china and art ware potteries in Khurja, members of KPMA, weighing a kiln upgrade

ul: About 400 units: 150 stoneware crockery, 80 electrical kit-kat fuse parts, 60 art ware, 15 insulators, 15 bone china, and smaller groups plus about 50 dependent potters.
156 kilns: 91 tunnel kilns of 2 to 9 tonnes a day, 60 shuttle kilns and 5 old downdraft kilns. Coal has gone with the downdraft kilns.
A year's energy: 19,032 kL of LDO and RPO, 1.5 million scm of gas and 27.7 million kWh. Heat is 80 to 85% of a unit's energy, and energy 25 to 40% of its cost.
RPO is cheaper than LDO, but burns with more unburnt fuel in existing burners and needs more burner maintenance.

sections.h: Tunnel against shuttle: the number that matters
ul: A tunnel kiln uses about 4.3 MJ of fuel per kg of ware.
A shuttle kiln uses about 15.7 MJ per kg, about 3.6 times as much, because it heats and cools the whole load and kiln each batch with no heat recovery.
On oil, at IPCC's 74.1 kg CO2 per GJ for gas oil, that is about 0.32 kg CO2 per kg of ware in a tunnel kiln and 1.16 kg in a shuttle kiln.
Heat recovery on a shuttle kiln: about 7% saving. Short of 10% on its own.
Lighter kiln cars in a tunnel kiln: about 3% of heat input. Kiln automation: about 3%. Each falls short alone.

Replacing shuttle firing with a tunnel kiln, clears 10% by a wide margin. Combining heat recovery, lighter kiln furniture and controls in one project may clear it; the energy auditor's figure decides.
ADEETIE needs Udyam registration, a loan from a bank or financial institution, and an investment grade energy audit by an empanelled auditor.

example.title: Worked example: a typical shuttle kiln unit moving its firing to a tunnel kiln
lines: Shuttle kiln fuel: 64 toe a year x 41.868 GJ = 2,680 GJ
Ware fired: 2,680 GJ / 15.7 MJ per kg = about 171 t a year
Same ware in a tunnel kiln: 171 t x 4.3 MJ per kg = 734 GJ
Saving: 1,946 GJ, about 73% of kiln fuel, or about 54,500 L of oil
CO2 saved: 1,946 GJ x 74.1 kg = about 144 t a year
example.note: The 64 toe is TERI's typical shuttle kiln unit. Litres use diesel's IPCC calorific value at 0.83 kg per litre; LDO is a little denser, and RPO has no IPCC default of its own, so treat both as estimates.

senseible: Before the energy audit, Senseible can turn a year of LDO, RPO, gas and power bills into the monthly baseline per tonne fired that the auditor and the bank will start from.
